items.prompt: Close-up portrait of the head, neck and shoulders of a Hullbreaker, a huge alien hunting beast from a cold heavy-gravity world, hunched forward with the heavy rounded bulk of a great predator: a tall shoulder hump, a thick short neck, a broad barrel body and thick forearms ending in heavy curved claws. A thick coarse shaggy mane of black streaked with grey fur covers the hump, the shoulders, the neck and the back of the head and frames the face; the arms are thick dark leathery hide with coarse hair. The head is low, broad and blunt, sunk into the mane between the shoulders. The face is bare living hide armoured with thick matte bony plates of dark grey-brown horn, like the scales of a pangolin or the shell of a tortoise, dull, rough and porous like old weathered bone, ridged and chipped, with patches of dark leathery hide and coarse bristles between them. The jaw is split down the middle of the chin into two plated halves hinged at the sides, the left and right halves closed, meeting in a deep dark seam straight down the middle of the chin. A row of four small glowing amber eyes sits in one straight line across the plated brow, and rows of small dark heat-sensing pits run along the cheeks below them. A heavy scrap armour harness of rusty riveted hull plates from other ships and thick leather straps covers the chest and belly. This is Warlord Grax Ironmaw, the biggest and oldest pack-lord: a riveted iron plate bolted across the two halves of the jaw like an iron maw, one huge clawed hand resting on a heavy boarding hook, harness plates in clashing colours torn from three different fleets, chains across the chest.
